description:
Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base; 10 signed-wallet free calls shared over rolling 30 days. Read the backend 402 body for x402 terms. Prepare a reference envelope and deterministic source/destination binding digest. References and supplied hashes remain unverified. No destination is contacted, no acknowledgment is obtained, and nothing is delivered or persisted.
Operating boundary: Direct access uses x402 Base USDC settlement or the verified-wallet free tier. The prepared computation uses caller-supplied data and creates no execution authority, proof verification, delivery or provider action. Payment access records are durable; existing credentials and signed grants remain required for separate consequential actions.
POST /api/proof-relay. Existing product credentials, signed mandates, and single-use action grants remain required where applicable. This adapter grants no authority and never supplies server credentials. This current operation is a bounded computation on caller-supplied data.
name: wever_proof-relay
title: Proof Relay
